data.name: Widget.Description
data.value: Shows an app's unread count like the Dock does, and opens the app when tapped. Works with WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, Telegram and any other app that shows a Dock badge.

data.name: Face.ChooseAppHint
data.value: Edit this widget to pick one

data.name: Config.AppDescription
data.value: The app whose Dock badge this tile shows. An app shows a badge only while it is running.

data.name: Config.IconSizeDescription
data.value: How much of the tile the app icon fills. Lower it to make room for a label.

data.name: Config.BadgePositionDescription
data.value: Which corner of the tile the unread count sits in.

data.name: Config.BadgeStyleDescription
data.value: Pill and rounded square show the count on a filled badge, outline draws a colored ring around it, and dot only shows a dot without the number.

data.name: Config.BadgeSizeDescription
data.value: How big the badge is compared to the standard size (100 %).

data.name: Config.BadgeTextColorDescription
data.value: Color of the number on the badge. White by default; an outline badge uses the badge color unless you change this.

data.name: Describe.Label
data.value: Optional text shown with the icon, for example "Work". Leave it empty for an icon-only tile. The label color, font and size below only take effect once you enter a label.

data.name: Describe.BackgroundColor
data.value: The tile's background. Choose Transparent to let the folder background show through.

data.name: Describe.AccentColor
data.value: Color of the message badge. The Dock's red is used when this is not set.

data.name: Describe.FontSize
data.value: Size of the label text, as a percentage of the tile. Needs a label to have any effect.

data.name: Describe.TextAlign
data.value: Moves the label to the left, center or right.

data.name: Describe.LabelPosition
data.value: Puts the label above the icon, over it, or below it.

data.name: Describe.Border
data.value: A ring drawn around the tile.

data.name: Describe.BorderStyle
data.value: How the ring looks: off, a steady line, or an animation such as breathing or a running comet.
